senses.gloss: (cmp. כְּרוֹשְׁיָיתָא) tufts, tassels (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Fimbriae).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 7a:8">B. Mets. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>דתפיסי בכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 2 <he>בכרשתא</he>, corrected into <he>בכרדשתא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60) both taking hold of the fringes of the cloth (which they claim as finders).
